    int minCostFlow(int N, int[][] cap, int[][] cost, int src, int dst) {
        int[] potential = new int[N];
        Arrays.fill(potential, INF);
        potential[src] = 0;
        
        for (int iter = 0; iter < N; iter++) {
            boolean updated = false;
            for (int u = 0; u < N; u++) {
                if (potential[u] == INF) continue;
                for (int v = 0; v < N; v++) {
                    if (cap[u][v] > 0 && potential[u] + cost[u][v] < potential[v]) {
                        potential[v] = potential[u] + cost[u][v];
                        updated = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!updated) break;
        }
        
        int totalCost = 0;
        
        while (true) {
            int[] dist = new int[N];
            int[] prev = new int[N];
            int[] prevedge = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[src] = 0;
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < N; iter++) {
                boolean updated = false;
                for (int u = 0; u < N; u++) {
                    if (dist[u] == INF) continue;
                    for (int v = 0; v < N; v++) {
                        if (cap[u][v] > 0 && dist[u] + cost[u][v] + potential[u] - potential[v] < dist[v]) {
                            dist[v] = dist[u] + cost[u][v] + potential[u] - potential[v];
                            prev[v] = u;
                            prevedge[v] = v;
                            updated = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!updated) break;
            }
            
            if (dist[dst] == INF) break;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                if (dist[i] < INF) potential[i] += dist[i];
            }
            
            int flow = INF;
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = prev[v]) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, cap[prev[v]][v]);
            }
            
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = prev[v]) {
                int u = prev[v];
                cap[u][v] -= flow;
                cap[v][u] += flow;
                totalCost += flow * cost[u][v];
            }
        }
        
        return totalCost;
    }
